=== Gardening ===
''Items required: 2 buckets of compost or supercompost. ''

{{Checklist|* Return to Ellamaria’s garden and fill the 2 plant pots with compost.
*Plant everything. They take 10-15 minutes to grow and cannot die.
* Talk to Ellamaria.
* Talk to King Roald, options: 1, 2, 2. (Make sure you have the Ring of charos (a) equipped when talking to King Roald or he will not follow you into the garden.)
* Watch the cutscene.}}

Quest complete!
